headline: South African Tech Firm Altron Reports 5% Sales Growth
summary: South African technology group Altron reported a 5% increase in half-year sales to approximately $309 million. The company attributed the growth to a recovery in its IT services division and announced a 15% dividend increase.
why: Altron is a key player in the South African IT services market. Financial performance updates provide insight into the health of the regional enterprise technology sector.
